ValidationRule.description: If the Account Type (Type) field is "Military," the Military Authority Name field must be populated in order to move the Opportunity to "Closed" stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
NOT( ISNEW() ) &&
ISPICKVAL(Type, "Military") &&
ISBLANK(Military_Authority_Name__c) && ISCHANGED(Military_Authority_Name__c) &&
NOT(ISBLANK(Next_Closed_Drive__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Since this Military Account has an existing Blood Drive Opportunity in the "Closed" Stage, the Military Authority Name field must be populated
